purpose: Route the missed-clue audit into specialist Bible and chronology owners while distinguishing promoted relations, recovery targets, already-owned motifs and rejected/unsupported attractive parallels.

owners.research_target: replace generic walking/sight summary with Acts 9, Acts 3, John 5 and witness-response structure after provenance/date conflict is resolved

highest_new_findings: Yahya is John the Baptist's Arabic/Qur'anic name; the reported Yahya -> Jesus Christ/Lamb recognition therefore has an onomastic role-layer in addition to the already-known John 1 function.
The 2005 crash's reported no-broken-bones detail creates a retrospective Passover/John-19 comparator that predates later Lamb theology, but must remain non-romanticized survival testimony.
The 2015 fall is most useful because Luke 4 turns Psalm 91 protection into a countertext against testing God, preventing an invulnerability reading.
The 2017 promise to return every day/forever has a tighter temporal neighbor in Matthew 28:20 than generic resurrection language.
Childhood earthly-father teachings supply mundane Father/Son and measure-for-measure substrate before mature project theology.
Old assistant prose about carpenter/mason employment is not currently supported by the sourced biography and must not be promoted merely because it would create an attractive Jesus parallel.
method_result: The audit confirms that future mining should compare biography events against relation coverage mechanically and should score event density, source direction and chronology before symbolic attractiveness.
